title: Aoban Tools
description: A mod that adds many tools to your game, enhancing your late-game/mid-game experience! From emerald tools to knockback sticks, this mod has it all.
body:
This new mod adds custom tools and various ores, and adds a craftable knockback stick. New Tools will be added soon, such as more elytras, craftable bedrock, more pickaxes, much more. You can try out the mod today!


# Features/Items:


**Polished Emerald Ore:**
Emerald ore but polished! Shines brighter and is smoother. It gives emerald ingots!


**Polished Emerald Block:**
Use 8 Ingots and a brush to craft a block! Smoother and great for a slippery surface.


**Emerald Ingot:**
Mine Polished Emerald ore to get emerald ingots, or craft them with Emeralds and Redstone.


**Emerald Tools:**
Swords, Axes, and Pickaxes, much better than netherite or diamond in attack damage/mining efficiency.


**KnockBack Stick:**
Knock your enemies back with a stick! Craft it with redstone, a stick, and a book. (You need to be in survival to get knockback enchantment)
